name: sinonimia
description: Sinonimia — a plain-language dictionary of bureaucratic, legal, and health terms. Static HTML/CSS/JS, no build step.
// engines note: Sinonimia itself runs in any modern browser and needs no Node at runtime. The >=20 floor is what the validator script and older Wrangler versions need. The deploy workflow installs Node 22 explicitly because Wrangler 4.114+ requires it; the validator keeps working on Node 20 in validate.yml.
